title: onboard-lyra-lite-2b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Lyra Lite 2B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles for our supported target hardware, and update the changelog/release-notes automation to pick up new model metadata tags. Motivation: Lyra Lite is a compact family requested by customers for low-cost, low-latency inference in edge and burst scenarios. We need canonical metadata (license, tokenizer, quantization guidance), validated perf profiles for CPU and GPU targets, and to ensure our changelog automation surfaces model onboarding entries automatically.
commits: 3 commits: (1) Add lyra-lite v1 metadata and perf profiles; (2) Extend changelog generator to include model metadata tags and model-specific release notes; (3) Fix CI unit test for profile validation (flake) and update docs
review_comments: Evan Zhou (reviewer): Please add a note about tokenizer compatibility and the recommended tokenizer version in metadata.yml. Also can you tighten the GPU perf_profile latency p90 values to match bench runs?

Maya Patel (author): Added tokenizer_version and tokenizer_notes to metadata.yml and adjusted p90 values after re-running the micro-bench on a T4 cluster. Updated perf profile docs to note measurement methodology.
Priya Nair (reviewer): Changelog generator change looks good, but please add a unit test to cover when a model metadata entry is missing a release_note field (should fallback).
Maya Patel (author): Added test_model_metadata_collection.py to assert fallback behavior and fixed a None case in collect_model_metadata.py.

Samir Gupta (approver): Verified perf profiles and metadata schema with the registry validator. CI had a transient flake on the profile validation test which I re-ran; all green now. Approving to merge.
Automated CI comment: Integration tests passed (full slow suite). Security scan: no secrets found. Lint: no warnings.
release_notes:
- Add Lyra Lite 2B v1.0 to model catalog with canonical metadata (license, tokenizer guidance, recommended quantization profiles)
- Include validated performance profiles for CPU and GPU targets (p50/p90/p99 latency and throughput)
- Changelog automation now picks up 'model:onboard' metadata tags and emits model-specific release notes entries
- Add metadata validation unit tests and documentation
